He has been practicing swine medicine for over 20 years. Jeff is currently serving on the AASV Board of Directors and is involved with National Pork Board's Operation Main Street. alternates.evidence_quote: [Dr. Amy Woods]Amy Woods, DVM ... Dr. Amy Woods is a Purdue University College of Veterinary Medicine graduate and member of the American Association of Swine Veterinarians and the American Veterinary Medical Association. She previously worked in mixed animal practices where her primary focus was swine. Amy has been on the Indiana Veterinary Medical Association Board of Directors and has served on the Indiana Practice Act Review Task Force.
